summary: Iteration 5 (Stripe subscriptions, Dealer self-onboarding, About/Founder page, PWA) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/11 new pytests pass. 1 backend bug: GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} returns 500 (unhandled Stripe provider error) when the freshly-created session is queried — blocks the Premium post-checkout polling flow. Frontend: /about, /dealers/apply (submission + success), /premium (3 plan cards with correct CTA labels, Subscribe ₹199/mo successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com), Footer founder link, manifest.json & service-worker.js served, PWA install banner appears on iOS UA after 6+s — all verified.

critical.issue: Returns 500 (Internal Server Error) for freshly-created test sessions. Stripe lookup raises a not-found error for a session that was created seconds earlier, which bubbles up as an unhandled provider error. This breaks the Premium post-checkout polling flow — the frontend useEffect in Premium.jsx that polls /checkout/status/{sid} will hit 500 repeatedly and eventually show 'Payment could not be confirmed'. Fix: wrap the status lookup in try/except and either return {'payment_status': tx.get('payment_status','initiated'), 'status':'pending'} or return 202. Root cause is that the session may not yet be visible to the retrieval API immediately after creation, or test sessions may be short-TTL.

minor.issue: No pydantic validator on phone (accepts any string, e.g., letters). Same pattern as BookingRequest.
Returns all dealers including status='pending_verification' (unverified). For a public list this is OK for MVP but consider filtering verified=true once admin approval exists.
No auth — phone passed as query param; any caller can check any phone's subscription status.
origin_url is accepted as-is without validation. A malicious origin_url would produce success_url/cancel_url pointing elsewhere. Whitelist allowed origins.

integration_issues.issue: Because /api/checkout/status/{sid} returns 500 for just-created sessions, the Premium.jsx polling useEffect will retry 10× and then set paymentState='failed' → user sees 'Payment could not be confirmed' even on a valid flow (before card entry). Depends on backend fix above.

action_items: HIGH: Wrap get_checkout_status in try/except provider error inside /api/checkout/status/{session_id}; return graceful 200 with payment_status='initiated' (or last-known db status) + status='pending' when Stripe lookup fails. Currently a 500 breaks Premium return-flow polling.
MED: Add pydantic validator on DealerApplication.phone (10 digits).
MED: Whitelist origin_url in CheckoutRequest — currently any URL is accepted.
LOW: Consider filtering GET /api/dealers to verified dealers by default; add ?all=true for admin view.
LOW: Add auth to /api/me/subscription (same HIGH issue as /me/bookings from iter-4, still open).
critical_code_review_comments: /api/checkout/status has no try/except on the Stripe call — any upstream error => 500 to client. This is a production-breaking pattern (flagged as HIGH above).

server.py now ~935 lines (was 720 last iter) with Stripe + dealers + subscriptions + AI + bookings + OTP + image proxy. URGENTLY split into routers/payments.py, routers/dealers.py, routers/auth.py, etc.

PLANS dict, STRIPE_API_KEY, and checkout endpoints live in server.py as module-level state; should be a dedicated services/stripe_service.py with idempotency on transaction insert (currently every /checkout/session call inserts a new payment_transactions row even if same plan+phone within seconds — no dedupe).

/api/me/bookings and /api/me/subscription both accept phone as raw query param without token auth — two endpoints now with the same leak pattern (flagged iter-4 for bookings, still unfixed; now repeated for subscription).
InstallPWA.jsx registers service worker unconditionally each mount. Safe but could be gated by NODE_ENV=production to avoid dev-time caching confusion.
service-worker.js CORE list includes '/index.html' — in CRA builds the root HTML is hashed by build pipeline; cache key may become stale. Consider Workbox or omit static HTML.
DealerApply.jsx uses a.href='/dealer' for the post-submit redirect button — should be <Link to='/dealer'> to avoid full page reload and lose SPA benefits.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (About, DealerApply, Premium-Stripe redirect, Footer link, manifest, service-worker, iOS PWA banner — all verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-5 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py cover checkout session/status, dealers apply/list/filter, /me/subscription, manifest, service-worker. One known failure: test_checkout_status_returns_initiated_or_unpaid (500 from unhandled Stripe provider error). Once the main agent wraps the status call in try/except the test will pass. For UI: premium Subscribe ₹199/mo truly redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_… — DO NOT attempt to complete card entry. PWA banner only appears on iOS UA (desktop Chrome's beforeinstallprompt fires only under specific install criteria).
rca_of_the_issue: /api/checkout/status/{session_id}: the status lookup raises a provider error for sessions that were created seconds earlier. The endpoint has NO try/except around this call, so FastAPI returns 500. Regardless of upstream propagation delay, the endpoint must never 500 for a transient lookup failure.
